# Postpilot

> An AI LinkedIn growth tool: AI LinkedIn post generator, content calendar and scheduler, carousel generator, comment generator, profile optimizer and personal analytics in one workspace.

## Pages
- [Home](/): product overview, features and FAQ
- [AI LinkedIn post generator](/ai-linkedin-post-generator): write LinkedIn posts with AI in your own voice
- [LinkedIn content calendar](/linkedin-content-calendar): plan and auto-publish posts with the AI scheduler
- [LinkedIn profile optimizer](/linkedin-profile-optimizer): AI headline, About, Featured and visuals guidance
- [Pricing](/pricing): plans from KES 1,500/month
- [Privacy](/privacy): data and LinkedIn OAuth policy
- [Sign in](/auth): create an account or sign in
